div.div:
The rule, as code
Two kinds of edge fail it: a ProjectDependency whose path starts with :services:agent, and any dependency whose group starts with one of the four prefixes above. Violations are collected at configuration time into plain serializable data, so the task body never touches Project and the configuration cache can store the result.
